messages:
Maya (CS): Heads-up  Celmor renewal needs special handling. Procurement will only accept a PO with our vendor name formatted as in their system, and their signer is a delegated signatory in the UK. I tried sending the DocuSign amendment but it bounced. Need help coordinating finance + legal + AE.

Aaron (Finance): What net terms are they asking? if it's >30 we need AR signoff.

Sam (Celmor): @Maya we can do net-60. Our procurement team needs the PO to show "Celmor Analytics Ltd" and vendor code CA-LTD-042. Will email the signed PO once you confirm the amendment.

Maya (CS): copy  net-60 confirmed by customer. Aaron, can we accept net-60 for a renewal of this size?

Aaron (Finance): Net-60 is OK with approval. I'll route to AR for a sign-off and add a note to billing. Please confirm the official billing entity and VAT details.

Rachel (Celmor Legal): quick note from our side  we need the DPA reference included in the amendment and a clause that allows delegated signatories. Is there a standard snippet we can share?

Kate (Legal): I can provide a minimal redline. Suggest this clause to allow delegation:

```
Delegated Signatories: Either Party may designate an authorized representative to sign this Agreement on its behalf. Such designation must be communicated in writing and include the representative's full name and title.
```

Kate (Legal): I'll attach a redline of the amendment in DocSend: https://docsend.example/redline-celmor (internal).

Maya (CS): Sent the DocuSign envelope to rachel@celmor.com but DocuSign returned an error: recipient email mismatch per DocuSignBot.

DocuSignBot: Signature attempt failed  "Recipient email does not match signer identity (error code 102)." Envelope ID: 0a1b2c3d. Suggested actions: resend to confirmed email or use access code.

Maya (CS): @Sam can you confirm the email of the delegated signer? The PO lists "J. Patel (Procurement)" but the legal contact uses rachel@celmor.com. We need the signer email.

Sam (Celmor): Ah  sorry, delegated signer is j.patel@celmor.co.uk (procurement). Rachel will just be the legal reviewer. We'll ask procurement to confirm their signer's full name.

Maya (CS): Great  resending to j.patel@celmor.co.uk now. Aaron  tagging you: once signed we need to ensure billing shows "Celmor Analytics Ltd, VAT GB999999999" and invoice terms net-60. I'll include that in the amendment.

Liam (AE): I'll loop in exec sponsor to expedite. @Priya  can we offer a fallback if DocuSign fails again? Customer is time-sensitive.

Priya (CS Manager): If DocuSign bounces a second time, we can accept a scanned PO (signed) + a confirmation email from the delegated signer to legal. Need Legal + Finance to sign off on that fallback.

Kate (Legal): Agreed  acceptable fallback: (1) signed PO PDF from procurement, (2) emailed confirmation from the delegated signer's corporate address, (3) clause included showing delegation. Legal will add an approval comment on the Salesforce opportunity.

Maya (CS): Resend complete. DocuSign shows "delivered" to j.patel@celmor.co.uk. I'll monitor and post updates here.

DocuSignBot: Envelope 0a1b2c3d status: Delivered to j.patel@celmor.co.uk at 2024-06-15T14:22:31Z.

Sam (Celmor): Procurement confirmed they signed via DocuSign. Expect return by EOD. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Aaron (Finance): Once we receive the signed amendment, I'll queue the invoice with net-60 and the VAT details. Please confirm the PO number to put on the invoice.

Maya (CS): PO number from Celmor procurement: PO-58421-CA. Will add to the invoice. Thanks everyone  I'll close out when final signed copy is attached to the SF opportunity. :white_check_mark:
